question: Does WP89's `guard-0.01-0` (the WP67 trapped-chain restart rule with step ratio 0.01 instead of 0.1, scored at the close of the first non-empty slow window, transition 99 of the default schedule; a flagged chain restarts from an independent best-of-16 start) qualify as the sampler default? Tested unchanged on the 22 v7 posteriors x 6 fresh seeds against the shipped defaults, on the funnel tail check at 30 fresh seeds and on the WP84 SV model at 120 fresh seeds.
library_under_test: wt/trap-guard-confirm = main f5500db3 with no library change: the candidate is WarmupConfig::with_trapped_chain_restart(TrappedChainRestartConfig::step_rule().with_step_ratio(0.01).with_check_window(0)) behind the `research` feature, exactly as WP89 ran it (library 23785f41, merged). The `defaults` / `diag` arms are Sampler::new() as shipped, in the same `research` build (the research feature changes no default; WP89 smoke: custom_noop and lowlevel_noop bit-identical to defaults).

candidate.name: guard-0.01-0
candidate.rule: At the end of the first non-empty slow metric window (transition 99 of Stan's 1,000-transition schedule; check window 0) the multi-chain diagonal driver stops the chains together, reads each chain's step s_c at that transition and the median m over chains, and flags chain c iff s_c < 0.01 x m (at least 3 chains, at least 10 window transitions, every s_c finite and positive). A flagged chain is discarded and reruns the whole schedule from transition 0 from the highest-density of 16 fresh uniform(-2, 2) candidates (100 attempts each) on the seed stream splitmix64(base_seed ^ TRAPPED_CHAIN_RESTART_SEED_TAG) + chain, with the initial metric and step, fresh dual averaging and a fresh RNG stream; at most once per chain. Nothing is copied from another chain, so the restarted chain is an independent start and independent-chain R-hat stays valid. A run in which no chain is flagged produces exactly the draws, target calls and diagnostics of the run without the option.
candidate.why_0_01: WP69 (ratio 0.1): 3 of 5 flags across WP67 + WP69 fell on healthy or self-recovering chains (ratios 0.024, 0.027, 0.031) and one real lotka_volterra trap sat at 0.111, so 0.1 was neither specific nor sensitive enough. WP89: the 8 SV traps sat at ratios 1e-9 to 1.4e-3 and the healthy minimum over 156 control cells (funnel, earnings, eight_schools_centered, hmm_drive_0) was 0.07; at 0.01 the guard fired on the 8 traps and 2 near-traps (3.6e-3, 7.8e-4; both had the full trap signature at transition 99 and would have escaped by luck at 157 and 325) and on nothing else; `restart` (0.1) also fired on a healthy funnel chain (0.076) and an earnings chain (0.07).
candidate.what_wp69_failed_on_and_what_wp90_tests: WP69 failed (a) efficacy (0 traps to remove on fresh lotka seeds, 2 false positives at 0.024/0.027) and (b) one false positive on a passing earnings cell (0.031). Both failure modes are firings on chains that are not trapped. WP90 R7 counts every firing on Parts 1-2 against the frozen trapped definition and tolerates zero; WP90 R6 supplies the efficacy test on a model with a measured 1.7 % trap rate (SV) rather than lotka's 0.4 %.

machine: AWS c7a.4xlarge owalnuts-bench (i-05c712c79c74ae7f8, us-east-2), Ubuntu 24.04, rustc 1.88.0, lane 1: every build and cell under taskset -c 0-3, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, files under ~/lanes/trap_guard_confirmation_v1/ only; co-tenanted with another study on cores 4-15 (shared L3 and memory bandwidth): walls are 'pinned, co-tenanted' and are not used in any rule; trapped counts, draw hashes, gates, ESS and gradient counts are unaffected.

blocks.name: S
blocks.note: 120 fresh seeds x {defaults, guard}, seed-major (defaults then guard per seed); same seed = same 16 candidates and chosen start per chain in both arms, so an unfired guard cell must be bit-identical to the defaults cell

blocks.name: F
blocks.note: Neal's 10-D funnel, 4 x 2,000/20,000, 30 fresh seeds x {diag, guard}, seed-major

blocks.name: P
blocks.note: 22 v7 posteriors (17 house + 5 hard) x 6 fresh seeds x {defaults, guard} at 4 x 1,000/1,000; model-major in v7 order, seeds ascending, defaults then guard

run_order: S, then F, then P (the two short parts first so that the SV and funnel results exist even if the box is stopped). One process per cell, sequential; a started cell is never rerun; an errored or timed-out cell is a failed cell and counts against R2 and R7.

funnel.statistic: pooled mean over seeds of the retained-draw indicator omega < -5 (WP85 / WP66); s.e. = between-seed standard deviation / sqrt(30)

gates.note: v7 gates on every parameter of the tier's parameter set (ArviZ 0.23.4, rank R-hat, bulk ESS, tail ESS at (0.05, 0.95)); WP85 scoring

sv_trapped_rule.definition: WP89's frozen census with WP89's anchor (the medians over the 480 WP89 Part A nutpie chains of the chain-median retained log_sigma and h_last; artifacts/summary.json of STUDIES/sv_stuck_chains_v1): a chain is trapped iff |median retained log_sigma - anchor| > 1.0 or |median retained h_last - anchor| > 2.0. WP90 runs no nutpie arm; the anchor is frozen here.

trapped_definition.scope: R7 (Parts 1-2; reported on Part 3 too). A fired chain c of a guard cell is TRAPPED AT THE DEFAULTS iff at least one of T1, T2, T3 holds; a firing on a chain for which none holds is a FALSE FIRING.
trapped_definition.T1_chain_warnings: the defaults cell's chain warnings (ChainWarning: WarmupStep, WarmupLogDensity, SampledLogDensity, RHat, RHatCluster; the library's own detectors over the defaults run) name chain c
trapped_definition.T2_reference_shift: reference-tier Part 1 only: at the defaults, chain c's retained mean is more than 3 reference SD from the reference mean on some reference parameter (WP67 / WP69's trapped definition)
trapped_definition.T3_wp89_signature: the WP89 signature on the recorded quantities: chain c's step at the scored transition is below 0.01 x the chain median (true for every fired chain) AND its selected-state log density at that transition is below (median over the defaults' chains of the chain-median retained log density) minus iqr_factor x (median over chains of the within-chain retained log-density IQR), i.e. the chain is still far below the typical set at transition 99 by the library's own WP33 log-density scale (SampledLogDensity's rule applied at the scoring transition). Covers WP89's near-traps (full trap signature at 99, escaped later by luck), which WP89 counted as acceptable firings.
trapped_definition.restarted_chain_ok: the restarted chain is not named by the guard cell's warnings and (reference tier) its shift is at most 3 reference SD; reported with the guard cell's gate result

statistics.headline: WP72 form (c): per model, the per-seed ratio guard / defaults of min bulk ESS per gradient (gradients = every target call of the cell: start search, warmup, sampling and, on a fired cell, the abandoned run and the replacement pool) on seeds where both cells are ok, median across seeds; geomean over the 22 models, each needing at least 5 of 6 paired ok seeds (a model without 5 counts as failing R4). Reported alongside: the median of the 132 paired per-seed ratios with a 2,000-resample bootstrap 95 % interval, its range and the number of pairs not equal to 1.
statistics.bit_identity: per chain: the FNV-1a hash of the retained draws and the chain's total target calls; per cell: the pooled hash and the target's total call count (start search included)

decision_rules.R1: Part 1: guard passes >= defaults passes over the 132 cells per arm; every Part 1 cell completes (an error or timeout fails R1).
decision_rules.R2: Every unfired guard cell of Parts 1-3 (no chain restarted) is bit-identical to its defaults / diag cell: every chain's draw hash and total target calls equal, the pooled hash and the cell's total target calls equal. Every fired cell's untouched chains are bit-identical per chain (hash and calls). No cell of either arm errored or timed out.
decision_rules.R3: Part 1: no new divergences: per model, the guard's retained divergences summed over 6 seeds <= the defaults'; and no cell that passes at the defaults has more retained divergences in the guard arm.
decision_rules.R4: Part 1 headline (WP72 form (c)) guard / defaults >= 0.98 over all 22 models, with the paired per-seed median and its bootstrap interval reported.
decision_rules.R5: Part 2: all 30 guard cells complete and |pooled P5(guard) - 0.0477903522728147| <= 2 x its between-seed s.e.; the firing count on the funnel is reported (prediction 0). Unfired funnel cells are covered by R2.
decision_rules.R6: Part 3: the guard's trapped-chain count (frozen WP89 census) over the 480 chains is 0; the defaults' count is reported (expected about 8).
decision_rules.R7: False-firing audit: every firing on Parts 1-2 is listed with the chain's step, the chain-median step, the ratio, its log density at the scored transition against the chain median at that transition, T1-T3 and whether the restarted chain passed (restarted_chain_ok and the guard cell's gates); the number of firings on chains NOT trapped at the defaults (trapped_definition) over Parts 1-2 is 0. Part 3's firings are listed the same way for the record (the SV census is R6's).
decision_rules.R8: Library integrity: tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs passes without and with the research feature; tests/trapped_chain_restart.rs passes (research); cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings on the library and cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings on the study crate pass on rustc 1.88; git diff main -- src tests Cargo.toml Cargo.lock is empty (no library change).
decision_rules.verdict: QUALIFIES (proposed for the flip; the coordinator applies it) iff R1-R8 all hold; otherwise it stays research-only. An implementation error anywhere (a cell error, a bit-identity failure) fails the study.

If any, on hudson_lynx_hare-lotka_volterra (WP69: a real trap at ratio 0.111 and near-traps at 0.024/0.027 on 240+204 chains; WP67: traps at 0.0023/0.025) or GLMM_Poisson_data-GLMM_Poisson_model (WP85: 2 of 6 defaults cells had max rank R-hat > 1.1), and every one on a chain trapped at the defaults (T1 or T3). No firing on earnings (WP69 minimum 0.031, 3x above 0.01), accel_gp (0.143) or any other model.

predictions.P7: R8 holds; no library change is needed.

proposed_flip: If every rule holds, the coordinator applies: (1) Default: a const constructor TrappedChainRestartConfig::guard() (= step_rule() with step_ratio 0.01 and check_window 0; minimum 3 chains, 10 window transitions, replacement best of 16 uniform(-2, 2) candidates with 100 attempts) and a new constant sampler::DEFAULT_TRAPPED_CHAIN_RESTART: Option<TrappedChainRestartConfig> = Some(TrappedChainRestartConfig::guard()), installed by Adaptation::warmup_config's with_defaults for the sampler's own adaptation modes (DualAveraging, Paper) exactly where DEFAULT_CHAIN_RESCUE would be installed (Metric::supports_chain_rescue: the identity and diagonal facades; the dense and structured facades keep rejecting the option, so the default is not installed there). Adaptation::Custom stays as given (opt-out: a Custom configuration without the option; the constant may also be set to None by a research build). (2) Research gate: #[cfg(feature = "research")] lifted from WarmupConfig::with_trapped_chain_restart, TrappedChainRestartConfig and its constructors (step_rule, with_check_window, with_step_ratio, with_replacement_start), TrappedChainCheck, RunTelemetry::trapped_chain_checks and TRAPPED_CHAIN_RESTART_SEED_TAG; tests/trapped_chain_restart.rs loses its #![cfg(feature = "research")]. (3) Not a new kernel: ALGORITHM_REVISION and the kernel fingerprints (tests/kernel_fingerprint.rs pins walnutpie::RunConfig runs, which take no sampler default) do not move, the WP68 refinement_levels10_v1 precedent as with the MomentumSum, RejectLeaf and best-of-16 flips; sampler-level draws change only on fired chains (WP90 R2 is the measurement). (4) Python: no signature change; draws follow the Rust default; the config dict, DEFAULTS, README table and CHANGELOG document the restart (ratio 0.01 at the first slow-window close, independent best-of-16 replacement, at most once per chain, recorded in the run telemetry). (5) Docs: wiki/open-questions.md items 12, 19, 23 closed to this flip; the chain-warnings note states that a restarted chain is an independent start so independent-chain R-hat remains valid.
budget: about 3 h of lane time: Part 3 240 SV cells at about 2.3 s each plus trapped-chain overhead (WP89: 807k warmup gradients on a trapped chain) about 12 min; Part 2 60 funnel cells about 2 min (WP89: 120 cells in 2 min); Part 1 264 cells about 2.5 h (WP85: 264 cells in 2.5 h on one lane); builds, tests and the smoke about 15 min. Sized to the coordinator's 3 h.
